Before meeting Dr. Nidhi, I had consulted multiple therapists at QI, but unfortunately, nothing provided lasting relief. My case was eventually escalated to Dr. Nidhi, who at the time was the National Clinical Expert at QI Spine and focused primarily on more complicated cases.

Around the same time, I was also preparing to move to the U.S. for my studies, so physically and emotionally it was an incredibly challenging period for me.

What truly amazed me was Dr. Nidhi’s approach to treatment. Within just about a month, she helped me recover significantly — without relying on heavy equipment, weights, or therapy bands. Through precise movements, targeted exercises, and a deep understanding of the body, she not only relieved my pain but helped me regain my confidence and return to running and normal activities.

Over the years, I’ve reached out to her multiple times for different issues — including post-operative muscle stiffness after thyroid surgery, frozen shoulder, and recurring cervical flare-ups — and every single time, she has been patient, thoughtful, and remarkably effective in her treatment.

Dr. Nidhi is not just an exceptional physiotherapist; she is someone who genuinely cares about her patients and their long-term recovery. She has consistently been my go-to person whenever I’ve struggled with pain or mobility issues, and I’m incredibly grateful for her expertise and support.

I would highly recommend Dr. Nidhi to anyone dealing with cervical issues, chronic neck or back pain, vertigo related to spine conditions, post-operative stiffness, frozen shoulder, or complex musculoskeletal problems.
